```yaml
name: Deploy Docs on Commits to Main

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'docs/**'

permissions: {}

jobs:
  paths-filter:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

  trigger-website-deploy:
    needs: paths-filter
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      
      - name: Trigger Vercel Deploy Hook
        run: |
          curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"ref": "main", "sha": "${{ github.sha }}"}' ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
        env:
          WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL }}
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/deploy-docs-on-commits-to-main.yml` is designed to deploy documentation changes to the `archestra-ai/website` Vercel project. It triggers a Vercel deploy hook for the `archestra-ai/website` project's `main` branch only when changes are pushed to the `docs/` directory. The workflow requires a `WEBSITE_VERCEL_DEPLOY_HOOK_URL` secret to be configured in the repository. The workflow has default permissions set to none and includes a job to filter paths and another job to trigger the Vercel deploy hook.
